stories.title: Indonesia volcano eruption leaves 270,000 stranded as airports extend closure
stories.summary: Volcanic ash from Anak Krakatau kept Indonesian airports shut for a second day Monday, stranding about 270,000 passengers and grounding more than 2,000 flights, with long queues forming at Jakarta's main airport. The extended closures signal prolonged ash-driven disruption across Southeast Asian air travel.

stories.title: Rescuers search rubble for survivors after New Delhi hostel collapse kills seven
stories.summary: Rescuers worked a second day through the debris of a five-storey boys' hostel that collapsed Sunday in New Delhi's Satya Niketan, with the death toll reaching seven and more people feared trapped. Police arrested the building's owner, suspended five municipal officials, and Delhi's chief minister promised mandatory periodic structural audits for public buildings.

stories.title: Nepal holds a day of mourning after floods kill at least 1,300
stories.summary: Nepal held a national day of mourning Monday for more than 1,300 people killed in the Aug. 26 floods, which also left roughly 5,000 missing, with flags lowered at government offices. It was the 13th day since one of the deadliest flood disasters in the country's recent history.

stories.title: Trump vows unprecedented economic warfare to isolate Iran
stories.summary: President Trump announced what he called the "most crushing economic operation" against Iran, vowing unprecedented economic warfare to isolate Tehran. The declaration escalates the administration's pressure campaign against the Islamic Republic.

stories.title: Huawei's US racketeering trial opens in Brooklyn over sanctions evasion and IP theft
stories.summary: Huawei's US racketeering (RICO) trial opened Monday in Brooklyn federal court, with prosecutors charging the Chinese telecom with a scheme of sanctions evasion and intellectual-property theft dating to 2000. The case asks a jury to decide whether Huawei's rise was built on crime.

stories.title: $320M bitcoin exploit drains Liquid Network's federation wallet
stories.summary: Purported white-hat hackers withdrew about 4,000 of the 4,200 bitcoin - roughly $320 million - from Liquid Network's federation wallet, prompting Blockstream to halt all transactions on the settlement sidechain used by exchanges. Blockstream attributed the drain to a software bug in its Elements software rather than compromised keys, raising fresh questions about the network's reserve model.

stories.title: Inside Anthropic's tiny Labs team, the incubator behind Claude Code and MCP
stories.summary: Business Insider profiled Anthropic's small in-house Labs unit, credited with incubating breakout products including Claude Code and the Model Context Protocol as the AI startup's IPO nears. The team is deliberately built to kill bad ideas fast and keep starting over.

stories.title: Huawei's Mate XT2 trifold ships with homegrown, 'US-free' Kirin 9050 Pro chips
stories.summary: Huawei unveiled its first triple-folding smartphone, the Mate XT2, powered by homegrown Kirin 9050 Pro chips it says are free of US supply restrictions - days before Apple's annual iPhone launch. The device underscores how far China's domestic chip supply chain has come despite US export controls.

stories.title: By the Numbers: Key numbers from Ohio State's 56-3 win over Ball State
stories.summary: A stats-driven breakdown of No. 1 Ohio State's 56-3 season-opening rout of Ball State puts the Buckeyes' explosive debut in context as they prepare for a marquee home game against Texas on Saturday.

stories.title: Behind Enemy Lines: Texas site scouts Ohio State ahead of Week 2 showdown
stories.summary: A Texas-focused scouting preview of Ohio State highlights which Buckeyes flashed in the opener, including freshman running back Legend Bey, who totaled 74 yards from scrimmage and a touchdown in his debut. It sets the table for Saturday's top-tier matchup between the Longhorns and Buckeyes in Columbus.

stories.title: Lots to like about Ohio State's opening win
stories.summary: The Wilmington News Journal breaks down Ohio State's 56-3 win over Ball State in Saturday's season opener, finding plenty of positives for the No. 1 Buckeyes even though the blowout left some questions unanswered before Texas arrives.

stories.title: George Russell strikes defiant tone after 'real tough' spell
stories.summary: Mercedes' George Russell insisted he remains unbowed after a difficult run that saw teammate Kimi Antonelli pass him late to win the Italian Grand Prix at Monza. Antonelli now leads Russell by 66 points in the drivers' championship, nearly three race wins' worth.

stories.title: McLaren confirm review after Norris and Piastri almost come to blows
stories.summary: McLaren said it will review an incident after teammates Lando Norris and Oscar Piastri nearly came to blows during the Italian Grand Prix. Both McLarens finished ahead of Lewis Hamilton at Monza, but the flare-up adds tension to their intra-team battle.

stories.title: Fred Vasseur hints at potential Ferrari team orders change
stories.summary: Ferrari team principal Fred Vasseur hinted the team may adjust its orders policy after Lewis Hamilton criticised strategy during a difficult home race at Monza. Ferrari's 'disastrous day' saw it fail to challenge for victory as Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli won from 19th on the grid.

stories.title: East Columbus motorcyclist, 42, killed after swerving to avoid animal on Wilton Drive
stories.summary: Fredrick Hunter, 42, died after his motorcycle hit a utility pole Sunday when he swerved to avoid an animal on Wilton Drive in east Columbus. Columbus police are investigating and asking witnesses to come forward.

stories.title: Man arrested after alleged church arson near Ohio State campus
stories.summary: Columbus police arrested Lawrence Rose, 47, after he allegedly broke into St. Stephen's Episcopal Church at 30 West Woodruff Avenue near Ohio State's campus and set a book bag on fire in the basement. No injuries were reported in the Saturday-morning fire.
